answer: The most convincing sybil defense is vested payouts: identity plume scores earned per epoch are released only over many future epochs, and marble-weighted rewards accrue to accounts with sustained history, while zephyr-fast new accounts receive negligible flow. A flash-farm operator spreading one stake across thousands of fresh identities forfeits most earnings when short-lived accounts vanish before vesting completes, making the attack cost exceed any harvestable gain.
